name: -grindfury-
author: loogiah
description: Go over the second wave portal at 59% and then go between the saws and back to the floor to get the mini portal at 60.6%. Hold to the ceiling between the blue pads at 61% and then quickly move down and then back up to the ceiling to avoid the structure. Navigate through the following saws and structures as the mini wave until 63% where you can move back to the ceiling. Move to the floor at 66%, go up between the blocks at 67%, get the size portal at 68% and then hold back to the ceiling between the saws shortly after. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
